title: Mostra de Cuina Menorquina: the island's kitchen on show
description: Seventeen days to eat the island just as the summer eases off. Participating restaurants each serve a set Menorcan menu — traditional or brought up to date — at €29.50 a head, built on local, seasonal produce. Organised by Restauració Menorca and the Fundació Foment del Turisme de Menorca; the list of restaurants and their menus is published on the official site.
imageAlt: A shellfish stew served piping hot in an earthenware pot.
